nom: Kate Somerville EradiKate Acne Spot Treatment with 10% Sulfur

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report no bad effects and even prefer it for having no fragrance, while others describe severe breakouts, cystic acne, or stinging after use.
segments.dry: Reviewers note the product is inherently drying and recommend heavy moisturizing afterward, with one warning it can cause flaking if overused or applied beyond the pimple itself.
segments.combination: One reviewer with self-described sensitive, acne-prone combination skin reports it triggered painful cystic breakouts rather than helping.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report it effectively stops sudden cystic breakouts and hormonal/perimenopausal acne overnight.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples, whiteheads, or pustules flattening or disappearing within 1-2 days of overnight use; a few say it barely worked or made spots worse.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority describe blemishes and cystic bumps shrinking, drying up, or vanishing overnight or within a few days; a minority report no improvement or worsening breakouts after use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say it visibly reduces redness and inflammation around a pimple within hours to a day, with one reporting no fading of dark marks left behind.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers highlight that the product is drying to the skin and recommend moisturizing heavily, though a few say it did not dry or irritate surrounding skin at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with darker skin notes the product leaves a visible white film when applied, unrelated to oil control.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently mention dryness or flaking at the application site as an expected side effect, especially with overuse or when applied to the whole face rather than as a spot treatment.
concerns.aging: Reviewers in perimenopause or their 40s-50s report it works well on hormonal and cystic breakouts tied to that life stage.

extraits.titre: Beware if you have sensitive skin!!
extraits.texte: Looks like Caladryl but smells like rubbing alcohol. I applied it to 3 small places on my face and my face broke out severely, probably 10 times worse than it started out as. It had a reverse effect on me. I would be very cautious if you typically have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Good formula but not for everyone
extraits.texte: I was recommended this product from a friend of mine who said it did wonders for her hormonal acne. However it did quite the opposite for me. Broke me out the worst my skin has ever been in painful cystic acne. If you have incredibly sensitive acne prone/combination skin like I do, please patch test before! Really wish I could've liked this product.

I was first taken back by the "Do Not Shake" label on the bottle then I recalled the ingredients. Sulphur and yes, the smell of the product will remind you of its contents BUT ! so not let this pink powerhouse product fool you for one bit. THIS PRODUCT IS AMAZING and works overnight. At 54 I still fight the occasional hideous cystic acne flare up and this is my secret weapon. It has also greatly improved other problem areas on my face. I am so thrilled to of found this product. My advice, it wears on your face like calamine lotion does so use at nighttime and avoid a satin/silk pillowcase. I will buy this again and I highly recommend to all.

I'm currently going through perimenopause and getting acne because of it. I tried patches, I tried creams, and absolutely nothing works as well as this does! Yes, if you continue to use it once the zit is mostly gone, your skin will dry out. Common sense… Don't abuse your skin once the it is mostly gone! Sometimes it does sting a little at first when you put it on. But literally nothing will clear my skin up faster than this! And I use it directly on zits, or in areas where I'm starting to break out. I absolutely recommend this product!

This is my holy grail when it comes to acne! I sucfer from severe hormonal acne and when i get my flate ups, i run straight to this baby! I use it 2-3 nights in a row and my pimple is flat and gone! I have really senstive skin so it does dry out my skin but i moisturize heavily in the morning!

Curious to know why I have never used this product before.. Truly, this stuff is amazing! I have very sensitive, very acne prone skin - and sometimes it's the super annoying cystic acne. I have literally been using this product for barely a week and it works WONDERS! Others reviews that it is similar to Calamine lotion, is correct, in smell (which doesn't bother me,) color, and texture. However, it has more ingredients than your typical calamine and it works so well. It dries quickly and layers well with other face products. It's a tiny bottle, but I'm sure it will last a while. Although, I got this on sale, I would easily pay full price for how well this works. Try it out!

i bought this thinking it would help but it honestly made it worse. i started breaking out in the areas i used it in and my skin got so dry. i only applied it to the areas i needed but i didnt see results. my skin has gotten better without using it😕
